content.comment_body: Hello, I'd really like to be able to set the RTC of the [product_name] to a specific time using a designated block. Older systems allow linking an input to the RTC block so that, when the input is triggered, the RTC is set to a certain hour (e.g., 03:00 am). This would make it easy to update and synchronize the RTC with other systems supplying UTC or GMT using just an external dry contact. Is this feasible in a future release? Also, there's a 'Synchronization' menu in the clock settings—what exactly does it do? It seems related to synchronizing expansion modules, but I’m not sure about its precise purpose.

[product_name] models are not all the same. Please specify which [product_name] ([article_no], [article_no], etc.) you're referring to. However, no [product_name] currently offers the function you described. There's no block to set a specific time via digital or other input. In the current version ([version_no]), time can be synchronized using an NTP server, which requires an internet connection. For my setup, I use my router as a time server.

Thank you for your reply. I usually install [product_name] ([article_no]) in locations without ethernet (like mountainous areas). Without the ability to ensure the RTC shows the correct time, I have to visit the site every few months to adjust it. While I enjoy skiing, you can imagine how tough it is to access certain spots in winter! Given the situation, I might need to consider another solution, which is unfortunate.
To clarify, there is no dedicated block in [product_name] for synchronizing the RTC at a specific time.

Hello, The only method to synchronize the RTC in [product_name] is via NTP. Options include: 1) Synchronize with a PC running as the NTP-server on the network. 2) If no network is present, you can use the [product_name] communication module to sync the RTC with GPS, GPRS, or LTE via an NTP-server. Some mobile providers also offer NTP services you can utilize. Without using such an additional module, synchronizing the RTC isn’t possible. Hope this information helps.
Thanks for the suggestion to use the [product_name] communication module. I'll give it a try!

analysis.insight_summary: Users who deploy [product_name] in areas without internet connectivity struggle to keep the RTC accurate, as updating it remotely is not supported. The lack of a feature enabling RTC adjustment via a simple digital input or external contact is a substantial drawback, especially for remote or challenging locations. While NTP synchronization is available, it's not practical without network access, leading users to consider using additional communication modules or switching to other solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking a straightforward and offline method to set or sync the RTC on [product_name], ideally through digital input or external contact, without depending on internet connectivity.
